jobs_to_be_done.statement: Achieve: A daily ritual that surfaces the 1-3 things that truly matter.
Resolve: Everything lands on one undifferentiated list, so nothing feels urgent and the brain defaults to the easiest task.
Resolve: Too many tasks at once triggers overwhelm and freeze — people can't decide where to start (task paralysis).
Resolve: No differentiation between quick tasks and big projects, so important deep work is deferred.

differentiation: A minimalist single-focus ritual app that limits active daily tasks to 1-3 items, relegates all other entries to an out-of-sight secondary vault, and includes a single-button randomized selector for paralysis moments.
exclusions: Complex multi-tagging, nested folder hierarchies, or Kanban boards
Unrestricted visible backlog lists on the primary screen
Heavy analytics dashboards or friction-heavy setup wizards
